title: The Ram Who Woke Up
hero: the front ram facing the camera
still_parts: the other three rams, the dragon heads and the vessel body
character_design: A small stylized 3D bronze ram with the same dark silver-grey, lacquer-black patina, tightly curled spiral horns and scale-and-spiral pattern as the zun's rams, with big bright expressive eyes and a cheerful, curious face.
look: Stylized 3D animation inside a dim museum glass case on a white plinth, warm ceiling spotlights glinting off silvery-grey bronze against a dark background.
voice: A warm, friendly young male voice with a light neutral accent, speaking at an easy, cheerful pace as a voiceover.

lines.text: Hi! I'm one of the four rams on this bronze zun.
I'm about three thousand years old, from China's Shang Dynasty.
Long ago, I held wine for sacred ceremonies.
I was dug up in Hunan in 1938.
During the war, I was badly damaged, then repaired.
Now I live at the National Museum of China.

beats.action: Holds head-on at eye level on the still zun under its looming square mouth, as in the photo; the front ram's eye blinks by the third second.
Pushes in as the front ram wiggles, cracks its neck free from the vessel with a bronze creak, shakes its spiral horns and grins at the camera.
Bursts the ram out of the zun in a big leap over the flared rim, landing hard on the white plinth, hooves skidding, proud and silent.
Tilts up as the ram trots fast around the base while amber light rises like wine inside the vessel, making the scale patterns glow gold.
Orbits the zun as it splits into floating bronze pieces, the ram ducking between them, then every piece snaps back together with a ringing clang.
Pulls back to the opening angle as the ram springs into its corner and freezes into bronze; the zun stands whole and still, one last wink glinting.

sounds: soft bronze creak as the ram's neck pulls free
heavy metallic clank of hooves landing on the plinth
gentle liquid swell as amber light rises in the vessel
bright ringing clang as the floating pieces snap back together
tiny chime with the ram's final wink
